configurations.//: autoPort is off on purpose. The bridge only accepts WebSocket origins on localhost:5173-5199 and 4173-4199, so a port picked outside that range starts a face that looks perfectly alive and can never reach the brain.
configurations.name: jarvis
configurations.//writes: This local launch config passes --writes, so JARVIS can act here — click and type in Chrome, drive the phone, run shell. The README's read-only default still holds for a fresh clone's plain `npm start`; remove "--", "--writes" below to match that here too.
